name: Tōfuku-ji Temple
heritage: National Treasure of Japan; Place of Scenic Beauty
text: Tōfuku-ji (東福寺) is a Buddhist temple in Higashiyama-ku in Kyoto, Japan. Tōfuku-ji takes its name from two temples in Nara, Tōdai-ji and Kōfuku-ji. It is one of the Kyoto Gozan or "five great Zen temples of Kyoto".

depictions.name: Tofukuji Temple
depictions.text: Tōfuku-ji (東福寺) is a Buddhist temple in southern Kyoto, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited the temple and recovered three lost pages from its grounds.
